text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: EU-prod autoscaler reporting sustained queue_depth > 1200 and spikes in throttle_events (tokens/sec drop). Affected service: inference-runtime-v2. Severity: P2. Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/autoscale-eu?orgId=1 , runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Autoscale+Runbook

oncall: Paging — I'm on it. Passing to Ajay (eng-sre) for scaling + Maria (eng-runtime) for fallback routes.

ajay: seen. Checking current replica counts and tokens/sec metrics. My initial hunch: short-lived traffic bursts + large batching causing queue buildup.

maria: looking at model routing — fallback to smaller-quantized variant is enabled but traffic didn't switch cleanly. Investigating route evaluation logs.

sam: I can open a hotfix to increase min_replicas in the autoscaler for EU-prod while we root cause. Want to avoid churn if it's just a burst.

ajay: do it. Temporary bump to min_replicas=20 from 8. I'll also raise the scale_window to 30s to reduce flapping. Command:```bash
kubectl patch hpa inference-eu -n production --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":20}}'
```

leo: I'm tuning the token-limiter at the edge to shed non-critical background jobs. Applying a quick rate limit: `X-Client-Priority: low -> 1 req/s` for batch endpoints.

emily: customer-impact check: looking at support logs — 3 customers reported higher latencies and 1 saw 429s in the last 10m. Not widespread but visible on high-throughput routes.

ajay: deploy-bot, can you confirm the HPA patch rollout?

deploy-bot: Patch applied to inference-eu HPA. New minReplicas=20. Observability: new pods scheduled, expected warm-up 45s.

ajay: seeing queue depth drop starting to trend down after new pods come up. tokens/sec recovering. Throttle_events rate down 60%. Good.

maria: fallback routing fix: discovered a bug in readiness probe for quantized-variant that prevented it from being selected. Patching now and will restart the selector. Patch: ```diff
- readiness probe path: /healthz
+ readiness probe path: /ready
```

sam: applied canary patch to selector in EU (2 instances). Monitoring.

emily: CC product/sales on customer notices. Raising an incident note in PagerDuty incident: PD-3671 with impacted tenants listed.

ajay: mitigation summary: increased min_replicas -> reduced queue, applied edge rate-limits for low-priority batch routes, restarted selector for quantized variant. Latency back to baseline for 95th.

leo: follow-ups (post-incident):
- create a composite alert to reduce noise: require queue_depth > 1000 AND throttle_rate > 5/min for 2m before firing.
- add tokens/sec trend to the autoscale decision as a secondary signal.
- add a dashboard tile showing model-variant readiness + rollout status.

emily: agreed. I'll file the ops ticket for alert tuning and the dashboard work. Ticket: RDW-OPS-2145. Assigning to Ajay for alert rule, Maria for variant readiness dash.

ajay: quick draft for alert rule (Prometheus-ish): ```yaml
- alert: AutoscaleHighQueueWithThrottle
  expr: |
    sum(rate(inference_queue_depth[1m])) by (cluster) > 1000
    and increase(throttle_events_total[2m]) > 5
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```

maria: for the dashboard I'll add a boolean tile that flags when fallback-variant-ready=false so SREs can see routing mismatches immediately.

oncall: current status: mitigation complete, no active paging. Will keep watch for 30m then hand back to normal on-call.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, customers impacted: small subset, next steps tracked in RDW-OPS-2145, incident status: monitoring.

ajay: retrospective notes for postmortem: short-term mitigations were effective, root cause likely twofold — readiness probe mismatch on fallback variant and autoscaler thresholds too sensitive to queue spikes. We'll propose: increase scale_window, add tokens/sec gating, and tighten readiness checks in onboarding.

emily: I'll schedule a 30-min post-incident review tomorrow and invite runtime, SRE, and product.

sam: small docs change: add a section in the autoscale runbook about using composite alerts rather than raw queue depth.

leo: assigning follow-ups: RDW-OPS-2145 (ajay,maria), RDW-OPS-2146 (dashboard, maria), RDW-OPS-2147 (runbook update, sam).

oncall: handing off to night oncall in 30m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
